name: pace-fast
_about: Measured pacing overlay (herk-edit-kit EDITING-PLAYBOOK, 27 top Reels, MIT): shots average 1.1-1.4 s and never pass 2.8 s, the first cut lands at 0.6-1.0 s, no dead air over about 0.2 s between phrases with the beat after a comma kept, 1-3 word captions that hard-swap and appear two frames early, the speaker never away for more than 3.5 s. Applied on top of any preset with --pace fast or #fast in a dropped file name.
